scenarios.name: Place an order
scenarios.reason: The required confirmation breakdown values are absent from the confirmation and saved order record.
scenarios.diagnosis: The test treated the confirmation page as if it had to repeat the coffee and shipping line items. The stated check only requires the order-confirmed message and the €17.90 charge, both of which are present.
scenarios.suggestion: Update the confirmation assertion to require the order-in message and the €17.90 charged total. Keep the €13.00 subtotal and €4.90 shipping checks on the bag or checkout page unless the product requirement explicitly requires a confirmation-page breakdown.

scenarios.reason:
Added House Espresso and Paper Filters to the bag and opened the bag page.
Confirmed the order summary showed €4.90 shipping and a €49.40 total.
Increased the Paper Filters quantity by one.
The updated order summary showed free shipping and a €51.00 total.

scenarios.name: Promo code total
scenarios.reason: The entered welcome10 code returned “That code doesn't work,” leaving total €91.00 rather than the required discounted total.
scenarios.diagnosis: The bag does not accept the valid lowercase promo code required for this order.
scenarios.suggestion: Make the required lowercase code welcome10 apply the €9.10 discount, show Free shipping, and update the total to €81.90.
